text: This guide helps you update your address after you move into a new apartment. It’s not automatic.

section: Put your name on your mailbox
text: German apartments rarely have apartment numbers. Mailboxes and doorbells have no numbers, just names. To receive your mail, your name must be on your mailbox. How to put your name on the mailbox

Every time you move, you must register your address at the Bürgeramt. During your Anmeldung appointment, they put a new address sticker on your passport, personal ID, residence permit and vehicle registration papers. How to register your address

When you move, you must change your address in these places: Bank If you leave Germany, keep your bank account. You will still need it. Employer Your employer might need to send you documents, even if you quit your job or leave Germany. Health insurance Use your health insurer’s online portal. If you leave Germany, you can cancel your health insurance. Other insurers If you stay in Germany, you usually stay insured at your new address, but the price can change. If you leave Germany, cancel your insurance contracts. Electricity or gas company Read your electricity meter before you move out. You usually keep the same contract at your new address. If they can’t serve your new address, you can end your contract. Agentur für Arbeit if you get ALG I Beitragsservice for the TV tax Finanzamt Do it online in ELSTER, ask your tax advisor to do it, or email your old Finanzamt. Jobcenter if you get Grundsicherung Jugendamt If your children go to Kita, get a new Kitagutschein. Hunderegister if you have a dog Ordnungsamt if your dog is a dangerous breed Ordnungsamt if your dog is a dangerous breed Kfz-Zulassungsstelle if you have vehicles They will put a sticker with your new address on your Zulassungsbescheinigung. They can do it during your Anmeldung. If you forgot your vehicle papers, do it online, or at the Kfz-Zulassungsstelle. Use umziehen.de to tell companies your new address for free. They only share your new address with businesses that know your old address. You do not need to tell the Ausländerbehörde. When you do your Anmeldung, the Bürgeramt shares your new address. They also put a sticker with your new address on your residence permit.

To change your business address, you must update your address in these places: Finanzamt Do it online in ELSTER, ask your tax advisor to do it, or email your Finanzamt. If your new address is served by a different Finanzamt, you will get a new Steuernummer. Ordnungsamt or Gewerbeamt (if you have a Gewerbe) Künstlersozialkasse (if you are a member) Your website’s Impressum Your invoices

You might still receive letters at your old address. You can ask the Deutsche Post to forward mail to your new address. It’s called a Nachsendeantrag. It costs € 31.90 for 6 months. Forward your mail Mail forwarding is not reliable. Official mail from the Bürgeramt, Finanzamt, Ausländerbehörde and Agentur für Arbeit is rarely forwarded. Forwarded mail can take a week longer to arrive. Packages are not forwarded.
